column1: # Per-TF Fiber-seq footprint padding, in bp, added OUTSIDE the motif.
# The motif itself never changes: pad columns emit pwm['background'] in the sequence
# layer (identical to what the background state emits, so it cancels in the likelihood
# ratio) and the fitted +/-50bp Fiber-seq p-values in layers 5/6. Widening is therefore
# "left"/"right" are in the MOTIF's own 5'->3' frame, not reference coordinates. The
# reverse-strand block mirrors them automatically (right pad becomes the reference-left
# pad), the same way reverse_complement() mirrors the PWM.
# A TF absent from this file gets 0/0 = exactly today's behaviour. Only the 12 TFs with
# an individual Fiber-seq fit can be widened; the other 141 fall back to the scalar
# combined_low_count and have no per-column footprint to widen.
